program:
-- This method receives the browser requests
-- and decides either to return an user defined HTML 
-- document or to perform the Plant Simulation default action.
param request : string -> string	
switch request
case "$" 
	-- HTML window was opened
	result := HTML.cont
else
	var p := strLpos("+", request)
	if p>0 then
		result := HTML.cont
		var Frame:string := strCopy(request, 1, p-1)
		var FrameObj:object := Frame
		request := strCopy(request, p+1, strLen(request))
		p := strLpos("+", request)
		var objFile:string := strCopy(request, 1, p-1)
		var use3D := str_to_Bool(strCopy(request, p+1, strLen(request)))
		if use3D 
			if NOT is3Dopen
				open3D
			end
		else
			close3D(true)
		end
		
		.loadObjectAs(to_str(Folder4Objects,objFile),"",true,false)
		FrameObj.openDialog
		if use3D
			FrameObj._3D.openWindow
			if FrameObj.Eventcontroller /= void
				FrameObj.Eventcontroller.RealTime := true
			end
		end
			if existsObject(".Models.internal.Admin")
			   setExamNo(Frame) -- determine row 'ExamNo' in tablefile ExampleTab
			end
			
		ExampleTab.setCursor(2,1)
		if ExamNo > 0
			var code:string := ExampleTab[2,ExamNo]
			if strLen(code)>1
				executeSilent(code)
			end
		end
		
	else
		return
	end
end
